name: scrawling_crawler_each_player_draws_opponents_pay
notes: KNOWN TOOL BUG, fails today (M6 mapper, 2026-11-17): FDN Scrawling Crawler has no record, because `cardtool try/write` crash with GameOver in the G1 probe (the BACKLOG's M21 Sanctum of Calm Waters fault): the probe's battlefield card draws in the opening upkeep, before a two-player pack fills the libraries, and Probe.runner() builds that runner outside run()'s GameOver guard. The mapped tree (it passes this pack through `cardtool.py runpack FDN <this pack> --card 'Scrawling Crawler' --draft <draft>`): [0] TriggeredAbility(TurnPhaseEvent(UPKEEP, actor CONTROLLER_IS YOU), effect=EachPlayer(ref=ANY, effect=DRAW amount 1 controller YOU)) (M20 Dragon Mage's verified 'each player ... draws'); [1] TriggeredAbility(CardDrawnEvent(actor=CONTROLLER_IS OPPONENT), effect=LOSE_LIFE amount 1, controller = the referent 'event' Selector, the drawn card, whose controller is the drawer); then the compiled CREATURE carrier. Printed: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, each player draws a card. Whenever an opponent draws a card, that player loses 1 life.' The Crawler enters on seat 0's turn 1 (from hand). Turn 2: seat 1 draws in its draw step and loses 1. Turn 3, seat 0's upkeep: each player draws a card; seat 1, an opponent, loses 1 more; seat 0 draws again in its draw step and loses nothing. Seat 0: 2 cards, 20 life; seat 1: 2 cards, 18 life.
